participant_1.name: Eleanor
participant_1.personality: Wise and reflective, with a love for the arts and nature.
participant_1.background: i feel like i might live forever. i am 100 years old. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i remember when nobody had a television. i am very strong for my age.

participant_2.name: Charlie
participant_2.personality: Playful and imaginative, with a quirky sense of creativity.
participant_2.background: i like to talk but people have a hard time understanding. i like to look at blocks and sing about letters. i like to eat chocolate candy. when i grow up i want to be a dog.
